pkgmetadata.longdescription: neocmakelsp is a Language Server Protocol server for CMake, written in Rust on top of tree-sitter. It provides completion (including the commands, variables and packages CMake knows about), hover documentation, go-to-definition, document symbols, diagnostics from cmake-lint and a built-in formatter. It talks LSP over stdio or TCP, and the same binary can format or search CMake files from the command line.
